# Creative Work Type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:CreativeWorkType`](gmeow-CreativeWorkType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CreativeWorkType>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The kind of a creative work — a VALUE vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses) characterizing a [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md). Literary, musical, visual, and software are examples; the set is open.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:CreativeWorkType`](gmeow-CreativeWorkType.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for characterizing a [`Work`](gmeow-Work.md)'s kind — literary, musical, visual, software, dataset; an open set of individuals.

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting per-kind subclasses of [`Work`](gmeow-Work.md) ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9) — the kind is a value, not a subclass) and avoid conflating it with manifestation format ([`gmeow:ManifestationFormat`](gmeow-ManifestationFormat.md)) or genre ([`gmeow:Genre`](gmeow-Genre.md)).

### How to use

- Reference a seeded [`gmeow:CreativeWorkType`](gmeow-CreativeWorkType.md) individual from a [`Work`](gmeow-Work.md); extend with new individuals (not subclasses) when a domain needs a finer kind.

### Examples

- [`gmeow:workTypeLiterary`](../individuals/gmeow-workTypeLiterary.md) a [`gmeow:CreativeWorkType`](gmeow-CreativeWorkType.md).
